.docs/planning/sharedAiBrainBrief.md:48:### Decision 1 — Confluence is the only authoritative source
.docs/planning/sharedAiBrainBrief.md:50:All team knowledge flows into the Shared Brain from Confluence. No other source. Decisions made in Claude.ai sessions, Slack, or email do not enter the Shared Brain until a human writes them into a properly templated Confluence page.
.docs/planning/sharedAiBrainBrief.md:52:**Rationale:** Confluence is the tool every team role — including non-technical members — can write to without friction. Having a single authoritative source prevents the "which version is correct" problem that kills RAG quality.
.docs/planning/sharedAiBrainBrief.md:54:**Implication for build:** The ingestion pipeline reads from Confluence only. No Git-to-Confluence sync, no Slack integration, no direct Claude Code writes to the knowledge base.
